visualCharacteristics: Stack of collapsible items separated by light grey hairlines
Heavy-weight label on the left, plus sign on the right that turns into a minus when open
Items closed by default; body is plain rich text
contentPattern: Second cell: the body (paragraphs, bold lead-ins, lists, links)
usage: Disclosures that hide secondary detail on a page, e.g. 'View transcript' under a video, 'More on our values' and 'Our groups' on About SEI.
reuseGuidance: Use for optional detail a reader opens on demand. Each row is one disclosure; place several rows in one block for a list. For switching between peer panels use tabs.
